visualCharacteristics.purpose: Breadcrumb trail showing the current page position in the site hierarchy
visualCharacteristics.layout: White bar between header and main; full trail with chevrons (>= 720), single back link (< 720)
notable: Trail generated from URL ancestors using fetched page titles
Authored list of links replaces the generated trail
Moved outside main above the content

contentPattern.structure: one placeholder cell, or optionally a list of links whose last item is the current page

usage: Use at the top of every subpage to show the hierarchy path.
reuseGuidance: Fits pages within the site hierarchy; not for the homepage or in-page navigation.
